summary: First end-to-end test of HomeFix Pro. Backend: 38/38 pytest cases pass (auth, catalog, coupons, booking lifecycle, admin assign, tech accept→in_progress→complete, review, contact, Stripe checkout URL, dashboards). Frontend: full booking wizard (date-picker, time slot, city, address, problem, WELCOME10 coupon, cash payment) works end-to-end. Admin assigned technician, technician moved booking through accepted→in_progress→completed, customer submitted 5-star review, change-password worked. Stripe online checkout returns a valid https://checkout.stripe.com URL. Fixed one real bug (tech dashboard 500) during testing.

issues: Home page has hero, categories, popular services, floating call/whatsapp buttons but no visible 'Testimonial' or 'FAQ' section (keywords 'testimonial'/'FAQ' not found in body text) — may be styled with different wording; verify against PRD if these sections are required.
Search input only triggers on Enter key press (no debounce/onChange). Users typing may expect live filtering. Minor UX polish.

action_items: Consider adding testimonial + FAQ sections on Home if PRD requires them (not detected).
Optional: add debounced live search on /services (currently Enter-only).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1077 lines (single file). Consider modularizing into routers (auth, bookings, payments, admin) for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
Fixed bug: /api/dashboard/technician projected {rating_avg:1, rating_count:1} without excluding _id, causing ObjectId serialization 500. Added {_id: 0} to fix.

Login lockout logic in /api/auth/login sets locked_until on every failed attempt including the first; effectively any failed attempt sets a 15-min window but only enforces after count>=5. Works but semantically confusing.
CORS uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True — permissive but functional for preview; tighten to explicit origins for production.
cookie SameSite=None + Secure works for cross-site (frontend on preview URL); good.
customer_dash & tech_dash count via multiple count_documents; can be aggregated to 1 pipeline for perf (nit).
test_credentials: admin@homefix.pro/admin123, customer@homefix.pro/customer123, tech@homefix.pro/tech123 — all working. bcrypt hashes start with $2b$ as expected.
seed_data_creation: Created bookings 4acbcd7c-... (cash WELCOME10 → assigned → accepted → in_progress → completed → reviewed 5★) and 4bca490e-... (online payment; Stripe checkout URL generated). Multiple TEST_ prefixed bookings from pytest suite persist in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend all-green. Fixed tech-dashboard ObjectId bug. Booking wizard date-picker calendar popover intercepts clicks after date selection — press Escape before clicking time slots. Assign select on admin/bookings uses data-testid='assign-{bookingId}'. Tech action buttons: accept-btn, start-btn, complete-btn. Review UI: star-1..star-5, review-comment, submit-review-btn. Change-password: cur-pw, new-pw, save-pw. Stripe checkout URL confirmed working; not automating Stripe UI.
rca of the issue: Bug found: GET /api/dashboard/technician returned 500. RCA: line 859 called `db.users.find_one({'id':...}, {'rating_avg':1,'rating_count':1})` — this Mongo projection did not exclude _id, so returned dict contained ObjectId which FastAPI couldn't JSON serialize (jsonable_encoder → TypeError 'ObjectId' object is not iterable). Mitigation: added `_id: 0` to projection. Verified with pytest — passes now.
